output.one_liner: Attio is a cloud-based CRM platform that enables teams to manage pipelines, deals, and customer relationships through AI-powered agents and revenue orchestration.

auth.notes: OAuth 2.0 with Authorization Code Grant Flow recommended for multi-workspace apps. API keys available for single workspace. Bearer token used in Authorization header. HTTP Basic Auth also supported.

evidence.snippet: There are two ways to generate an access token: By implementing an OAuth 2.0 flow or By generating an API key for your workspace.
Attio implements the standard OAuth 2.0 specification, using the Authorization Code Grant Flow.
Pass the value of the token in the Authorization header of your requests like so. Authorization: Bearer <access_token>

access.notes: Free plan available at no cost for up to 3 users, includes API, webhooks, MCP server, and App SDK. All new workspaces get 14-day free trial of Pro plan.

evidence.snippet: Yes. The Free plan costs nothing for up to three users. It includes Ask Attio, automatic enrichment, workflows, and email and calendar sync.
Yes. Every new Attio workspace starts with a 14-day free trial of the Pro plan, with access to all Pro features.
Free plan: For individuals to get started with Attio. API and webhooks, MCP server, App SDK.

api_surface.rate_limit_note: 100 requests/second read, 25 requests/second write. Score-based limits on List records/entries endpoints.

evidence.snippet: Attio provides a public REST API which exchanges JSON over HTTPS.
Attio exposes a public OpenAPI specification for the Attio REST API.
Our rate limit across the whole API is 100 requests per second for read requests, 25 requests per second for write requests.
Webhooks allow you to subscribe to changes that happen in Attio and receive real-time HTTP requests to a target URL.
Add https://mcp.attio.com/mcp as a remote MCP server and complete the OAuth authentication when prompted.
MCP server exposing Attio CRM records, deals, and pipelines to agent clients. Needs Node and an Attio API key.

buildability.rationale: Self-serve free credentials with documented REST API, OpenAPI spec, official MCP server, and OAuth2 support enable immediate toolkit development.

overview_evidence.snippet: Attio is the platform that builds pipeline, advances deals, and grows accounts around the clock.
Connect your GTM stack with the REST API, App SDK, or Attio MCP.
